domain.rho: strictly positive four DC factors; no clamping

N01.support_algorithm: minimal integer K>=1 satisfying survival-function union tail / exact DC total <= tolerance; exponential bracket then binary search; no dense matrix until K found
N01.on_limit: explicit exception with diagnostic, no normalized candidate published
N01.timing: same process, per call perf_counter; no performance superiority inference
N01.pass: all predefined cases meet errors/invariants; unsupported domains fail explicitly

N02.decimal_odds: finite real nonbool >1, 2..32 exhaustive mutually exclusive selections, explicit contract acknowledgement

regimes.overround: solve requested method without silent fallback
regimes.fair: abs(overround)<=1e-12: normalized inverses with FAIR status
regimes.underround: default reject; explicit proportional scenario allowed and marked method_used=proportional

N02.brier: mean over matches of sum over 3 classes squared error; range 0..2
N02.log_loss: mean negative natural log of true-class probability, clipped below 1e-12; report number clipped; clipped score not strictly proper at boundary
N02.calibration: per-class fixed bins [0,.2,.4,.6,.8,1], count/mean_pred/frequency; empty null; no fitting or empirical real-model claim

N03.execution: exact AST source extraction plus documented imports; SQLite :memory: only, no operational modules initialized
N03.mutation: source-level single-rule removals/inversions on extracted existing functions and new adapter; same original tests executed against every mutant; killed only by changed assertion, not import/compile failure
N03.pass: all expected controls; report surviving and equivalent/no-witness mutants separately, no survivor hidden
N03.authenticity: not tested; synthetic clocks prove only rule behavior

runner.environment: explicit allowlist; no inherited credentials; canary absence tested
runner.network: Python audit hook blocks socket creation/connect; no OS firewall claim
runner.filesystem: Python audit hook permits reads only within this run and Python runtime, writes only evidence; sqlite memory only; no OS filesystem sandbox claim
runner.processes: audit denies spawning; Windows JobObject active-process=1 and memory=768MiB if assignment works, otherwise runner refuses start
runner.limit_probe: separate sleep probe verifies timeout; no numerical results used
